title: an ordinary sidecar carrying an unknown top-level key is accepted
why: Schema v1 allows additional properties, so a purely additive optional key
from a future minor revision must load cleanly and be ignored.
This fixture's job is to fail if validation is ever tightened into a
blanket 'unknown key = reject' rule. Every other fixture in this corpus is
satisfied by making the validator stricter; this one can only be satisfied
by making it stricter in exactly the right place, and no other.
Accepted at the shared validator only — the loader that must accept it.
Driving an accept case through the manifest-bypassing plugin loader would
prove nothing about validation: past the gate, both languages would proceed
to load a stub artifact and fail for an unrelated reason.
